title: 법원조사관 등 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:02556:20140901:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum to the Rules on Adjudication of Child Protection Cases <Supreme Court Rule No. 2556, September 1, 2014>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on September 29, 2014.

Article 2
Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendment of Other Rules)
(1) and (2) Omitted.
(3) Part of the Rules on Court Investigation Officers, etc. shall be amended as follows:
In the main sentence of Article 2 (2), "family investigation officers, juvenile case investigation officers, and domestic protection case investigation officers" shall be replaced with "family investigation officers, juvenile case investigation officers, domestic protection case investigation officers, and child protection case investigation officers".
In Article 3 (3), "family investigation officers, juvenile case investigation officers, and domestic protection case investigation officers" shall be replaced with "family investigation officers, juvenile case investigation officers, domestic protection case investigation officers, and child protection case investigation officers".
